Lina Park: From the postmortem: repeated regressions after model swap during high-concurrency windows. We need specific tests and short owners to avoid recurrence.

Omar Haddad: Suggest 3 actions: 1) a focused regression that replays the exact agent traces we saw, 2) a promptset to exercise long-prefix + kv eviction, 3) lightweight chaos that kills one GPU during warmup. I can take the replay runner.

Becca Ruiz: I'll own the promptset and add assertions around variant choice + response prefix integrity. Plan to add it as `tests/evals/promptsets/eviction_long_prefix.yaml`. Target PR in 3 days.

Lina Park: Ops asks: add alerting if nightly replay fails 2x in a row and surface eviction_rate. Also add a dashboard tile for fallback_count.

Omar Haddad: I'll wire the nightly job into CI and include a small smoke check that fails fast. Running locally: `python repro/replay.py --trace traces/2025-02-02.json --fast`

ops-bot: Created ticket #INC-4307 "model-swap-regressions: replay + promptset + chaos" assigned to Lina Park, due 2025-02-15. Sync scheduled: 2025-02-06 09:00 UTC.

Becca Ruiz: noted on dashboards. Adding a test expectation: `assert fallback_rate < 0.02` in the eval harness.

Lina Park: Owners: Omar -> replay + CI (3 days), Becca -> promptset + eval PR (3 days), Ops -> alert/dashboard (5 days). We'll run the chaos drill after the nightly shows 3 green runs.

Omar Haddad: I'll open the PR for the runner today.

Becca Ruiz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repro/pull/722 (draft).

Lina Park: Thanks everyone. Marking INC-4307 in progress. If anything slips ping me directly.
